description: Create a new View on a Team, Space, Folder or List. Provide exactly one parent id (team_id, space_id, folder_id or list_id) to choose where it lives. Returns the created View. Use to save a reusable filtered/grouped layout.

columns.description: Which columns/fields are shown and their order.

divide.description: Column/swimlane division config for the View.

filters.description: Filter rules that decide which tasks appear in the View.

folder_id.description: Parent Folder id — set this to create a Folder-level View.

grouping.description: Grouping config, e.g. group tasks by status/assignee/priority.

list_id.description: Parent List id — set this to create a List-level View.

name.description: Display name for the new View.

settings.description: Miscellaneous View settings (e.g. show closed, me-mode).

space_id.description: Parent Space id — set this to create a Space-level View.

team_id.description: Parent Team/Workspace id — set this to create a Workspace-level View.

team_sidebar.description: Team sidebar display settings for the View.

name: create_view
